verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Secureframe control for data retention periods or deletion of customer data held in the platform. Related items cover other things: drift-log 'retain or revert' applies to Azure Government resource changes, Trust Center 'hide or display' governs content visibility, and the MCP server's generic 'manage your data' does not describe retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
